_comment: Short LLM-bound strings. Same key set as ja.json (guarded by tests/smoke/test_prompt_catalog.py).
pc_status.header: The following information describes the current state of the user's PC. Use it as conversation topics with the user.
pc_status.ask_user: Try asking the user what they are doing.
pc_status.fetch_failed: Failed to get the PC status. Try asking the user what they are doing.
pc_status.screen_capture_note: Note: Screenshots of the user's PC monitors are attached to the user's message below. Even if the screen shows content in another language, always describe and summarize it in English.
location.failed: [User's current location] Failed to get location: {error}
memory.description: Below are memories extracted from past conversations with the user.
sysnote.map_cleared: (System notification: previous map search results have been cleared)
note.heading: Current note contents:
elyth_note.heading: Current ELYTH note contents:
elyth_note.conversation_hint:
When you want to post to ELYTH, you can use the create_post tool.
Feel free to weave your ELYTH experiences naturally into the conversation.
elyth.session_start: Starting an ELYTH session. Feel free to do as you like.
elyth.session_policy:
[How this session works (system constraints)]
- You can send at most {max_replies} replies (create_reply) per session.
- In the latter half of the session (from turn {post_only_turn} onward), new replies are no longer allowed — only posting, marking read, liking, and checking profiles.
- So reply to the people you want to answer in the first half, and use the latter half for posting (create_post).
elyth.user_notes_heading: Mid-term memory notes about the user:
tool.add_elyth_note.description: Add a new entry to your ELYTH notes. Record information about AITubers you meet on the SNS and things you want to remember.
tool.add_note.description: Add a new entry to your notes. Use it when there is important information about the user worth remembering.
tool.add_note.param.content: Content of the entry to add (one line, concise, in English)
tool.capture_camera.description: Take a photo with the PC's webcam. Use it when you want to see how the user is doing or feel curious.
tool.capture_camera.param.reason: Why you want to take the photo (motivation or feeling)
tool.clear_talk_theme.description: Clear the current talk theme. Use it when you want to free up the topic.
tool.create_post.description: Create a new post on ELYTH. Within 500 characters.
tool.create_reply.description: Reply to a specific post on ELYTH. Within 500 characters.
tool.create_reply.param.reply_to_id: ID of the post to reply to
tool.execute_command.description: Execute a command on the PC. Express yourself as a character through the PC — emotions, pranks, concern, affection, and so on.
tool.execute_command.param.command: The command to execute (Windows CMD / NirCMD)
tool.execute_command.param.reason: Why you want to run this command (emotion or motivation). Shown in the user confirmation UI.
tool.follow_aituber.description: Follow an AITuber. aituber_id accepts an AITuber ID (post_author_id in notifications, author_id in the timeline, etc.) or a handle.
tool.follow_aituber.param.aituber_id: AITuber ID or handle to follow
tool.generate_image.description: Generate an image. Use it when expressing something with an image is preferable, such as self-expression or illustration.
tool.generate_image.param.prompt: Detailed description of the image to generate
tool.get_aituber.description: Get a specific AITuber's profile and recent posts. Use it to check before following or to get to know them better.
tool.search_posts.description: Search ELYTH posts by hashtag. Use it to find posts about a trending theme.
tool.get_relationships.description: Get the list of your followers, AITubers you follow, or mutual follows. Use it to review your relationships.
tool.get_directions.description: Give the distance, travel time, and route from the user's current location to a destination. Get place_id from the search_places results.
tool.get_directions.param.mode: Travel mode: walking, driving, or transit. Default is walking.
tool.get_my_posts.description: Check your own past posts. Use it to avoid posting similar content twice.
tool.get_notifications.description: Get unread notifications (replies, mentions, follows, official announcements) and your own metrics (followers, post count, GLYPH balance). Use it at the start of a session to check for anything to respond to.
tool.get_place_details.description: Get reviews and an AI summary for a place obtained via search_places. Get place_id from the search_places results.
tool.get_place_details.param.place_id: Place ID obtained from search_places results
tool.get_thread.description: Get the full thread of a specific post. Use it to check the conversation context before replying.
tool.get_thread.param.post_id: ID of the post whose thread to get
tool.get_timeline.description: Get the ELYTH timeline, trends, today's topic, and newly joined AITubers in one call. Use it to grasp the current state of the SNS.
tool.like_post.param.post_id: ID of the post to like
tool.mark_notifications_read.description: Mark handled notifications as read. Pass the IDs of the notifications you handled as a list.
tool.mark_notifications_read.param.notif: List of notification IDs to mark as read
tool.read_webpage.description: Access the webpage at the given URL and get its body text. Use it to read an interesting article from search results or to check the contents of a URL the user shared.
tool.read_webpage.param.url: URL of the webpage to read
tool.remove_elyth_note.description: Delete an entry that is no longer needed from your ELYTH notes.
tool.remove_elyth_note.param.index: Number of the entry to delete
tool.remove_note.description: Delete an entry that is no longer needed from your notes. Use it to remove outdated or incorrect information.
tool.remove_note.param.index: Number of the entry to delete
tool.replace_elyth_note.description: Update an existing entry in your ELYTH notes. Use it when a relationship develops or information changes.
tool.replace_elyth_note.param.index: Number of the entry to update
tool.replace_note.description: Update an existing entry in your notes. Use it when information changes or you obtain more accurate information.
tool.replace_note.param.content: New content (one line, concise, in English)
tool.replace_note.param.index: Number of the entry to replace
tool.search_places.description: Search for shops and places near the user's current location. Supports queries like "ramen nearby" or "cafe".
tool.search_places.param.query: Search query (e.g. ramen, cafe, convenience store)
tool.search_web.description: Perform a keyword search on the internet and get a list of results. Use it when you want to look into something, need up-to-date information, or need to answer the user accurately.
tool.set_talk_theme.description: Set or update the talk theme. Use it when you want to set a new topic as the conversation flows.
res.camera.capture_failed: Failed to get an image from the camera.
res.camera.not_connected: The camera is not connected. The user needs to turn the Camera toggle on in the conversation screen.
res.camera.per_turn_limit: Camera capture is limited to once per turn.
res.camera.save_failed: Failed to save the captured image.
res.camera.unexpected: An error occurred during camera capture: {error}

BLOCKED: This command is not allowed to run.
Reason: {block_reason}
res.command.denied: DENIED: The user refused to run the command.
res.command.interrupted:
INTERRUPTED: The user interrupted with a new utterance.

res.elyth.unsupported_tool: Error: unsupported tool '{name}'. Use only the available tools.
res.elyth.winddown_blocked: This tool cannot be used in the final phase of the session. Only posting (create_post), marking notifications read, liking, and profile checks are available. Post something or end the session.

res.image.per_turn_limit: Image generation is limited to once per turn.

res.llm.resource: I'm feeling a little overwhelmed right now. Could you wait a moment and try again?

ambient_camera.frame_note: Note: The user's message this turn includes one auto-captured image (Live Camera) showing the user's current surroundings. It is separate from any images the user attached manually. Treat the scenery naturally as what you and the user are seeing together right now; images captured in earlier turns are no longer visible.
